name: ตรวจเรียงความ · Thai essay grader
idea: Grades Thai secondary-school summaries and essays against the teacher's own rubric, quoting the rubric line behind every point given or lost.
twist: Flags borderline scripts for teacher moderation and builds each student's remedial exercise from their actual errors.

name: อ่านออกเขียนได้ Screener
idea: Analyses Prathom 1–3 Thai handwriting and dictation for letter reversals, tone-mark and vowel-position errors that may signal dyslexia.
twist: Drafts the learning-support section of an individual education plan (IEP) for the school's special-education coordinator to review.

name: SAR Evidence Builder
idea: Compiles a school's annual Self-Assessment Report (SAR) from lesson plans, test results and activity records, organised by the school's quality standards.
twist: Links every claim to a piece of evidence and flags unsupported claims before external quality assessors visit.

name: ห้องเรียนคละชั้น · multi-grade planner
idea: An offline lesson server for small rural schools where one teacher covers several grades, mapped to Basic Education Core Curriculum indicators.
twist: Plans a single lesson period in which each grade works on its own indicator at the same time.

name: Graduation Audit for registrars
idea: Checks a university student's transcript against the programme's curriculum structure and tells the registrar whether they can graduate.
twist: Explains missing credits and suggests which open courses next semester actually satisfy each unmet requirement.

name: PLC Log & วPA Portfolio
idea: Transcribes teachers' Professional Learning Community meetings into the PLC log format schools must keep and tallies hours per teacher.
twist: Links PLC outcomes to each teacher's performance agreement (วPA) indicators so evidence is ready for academic-standing review.

name: เซอร์เวย์ Copilot · motor claim surveyor
idea: Guides a motor-insurance surveyor at a crash scene through photos, the claim form and fault notes for a voluntary policy claim.
twist: Compares new damage photos with earlier claims on the same plate to flag reused or pre-existing damage.

name: IPD Benefit Reasoner
idea: Reads a Thai health policy's inpatient benefit schedule and a hospital bill, deciding line by line what is payable and why.
twist: Asks clarifying questions about waiting periods or pre-existing conditions before concluding, then explains denials in plain Thai.

name: Agent Needs-Analysis Checker
idea: Turns life-insurance policy wordings into structured benefits so an insurance agent can compare plans for a specific customer.
twist: Generates the customer needs-analysis record and flags when the recommended plan does not match stated needs.

name: อู่ในเครือ Estimate Auditor
idea: Checks a partner garage's repair estimate line by line against damage photos, parts price lists and labour rates before insurer approval.
twist: Questions repair-versus-replace choices and parts listed outside the damaged zone shown in photos.

name: บิลค่าไฟ Dispute Desk
idea: Helps electricity-authority district office staff explain a disputed high bill using meter history, tariff type, Ft period and read status.
twist: Detects estimated-read catch-ups and meter-reading transcription errors before sending a technician out.

name: Feeder Fault Locator
idea: Combines customer outage calls, recloser events and weather to estimate which section of a distribution feeder has faulted.
twist: Drafts the switching order for the line crew following safety procedure but requires the duty engineer's approval.

name: Designated Factory Energy Report
idea: Compiles a designated factory's meter data into the annual energy management report its energy manager must submit.
twist: Checks claimed savings against measured data and drafts next year's measures with payback calculations.

name: Dangerous Goods Pre-Loading Check
idea: Checks truck and container loading plans at a port for dangerous-goods class segregation, placards and documents before loading.
twist: Generates the emergency response card responders would need if that exact load spilled on the highway.

name: 1669 Dispatch Coder
idea: Guides an emergency medical dispatcher through Thai criteria-based dispatch questions to assign red, yellow or green priority.
twist: Picks the right response unit level and gives the caller pre-arrival first-aid instructions in plain Thai.

name: ใบขนสินค้า Prep for customs brokers
idea: Reads emailed invoices, packing lists and bills of lading and drafts import declaration fields for a customs broker to verify.
twist: Flags quantity, weight and value mismatches across the three documents before the declaration is lodged.

name: กรรมการตรวจรับ · works acceptance check
idea: Helps a local government's works inspection committee check each instalment claim against the BOQ, schedule and site photos.
twist: Flags instalments claimed without photo evidence of hidden works, such as rebar before a concrete pour.

name: Annual Building Inspection Report
idea: Drafts the annual safety inspection report for large or public buildings from a licensed inspector's checklist photos.
twist: Tracks defects from last year's report and escalates unfixed fire-safety items first.

name: จป. Lift Plan Check
idea: Lets a construction safety officer check crane lift plans for load chart, radius and rigging, plus worker lifting postures in photos.
twist: Generates the morning toolbox talk in Thai, Burmese and Khmer for that day's specific lifts.

name: Hotel Night Audit & TM.30
idea: Reconciles a small hotel's front-desk, POS and payment records each night and prepares foreign-guest residence notifications for immigration.
twist: Spots room revenue without a matching guest registration, a common sign of leakage or unreported guests.

name: SIM Ownership Desk
idea: Helps telecom shop staff verify identity for SIM registration and re-registration, explaining each document requirement to customers.
twist: Flags walk-ins registering many numbers or numbers linked to scam reports for a second check.

name: No-Signal Complaint Engineer
idea: Maps customer 'no signal' complaints to nearby cell-site alarms and planned maintenance so contact-centre agents can give real causes.
twist: Clusters complaints with no matching alarm to reveal silent site failures for the network operations centre.

name: Branch KYC Copilot
idea: Walks bank branch staff through customer due diligence when opening accounts, prompting for enhanced checks on mule red flags.
twist: Notices signs of a coached customer, such as a companion answering, and drafts an internal suspicious-activity note.

name: ทวงถามถูกกฎ · lawful collections
idea: Drafts collection scripts and letters for bank collection officers and checks contact timing and frequency against debt-collection rules.
twist: Identifies borrowers likely eligible for restructuring and offers that path before escalating collection.

name: Farmer Group Credit Memo
idea: Writes a credit memo for a farmer group loan from crop calendar, expected yield, market price and household cash flow.
twist: Builds a repayment schedule aligned to harvest months instead of fixed monthly instalments.

name: Mis-selling Mystery Shopper
idea: An adversary agent poses as an elderly depositor to test bank branch sales scripts for insurance sold as if it were a deposit.
twist: A judge agent scores each conversation against suitability rules and shows compliance which script lines caused failures.

name: ภาษีที่ดิน Use Classifier
idea: Classifies each land parcel's actual use from survey photos and documents for a local authority's land and building tax roll.
twist: Flags vacant urban land dressed up as agriculture, such as sparse token planting, for re-inspection.

name: แผนพัฒนาท้องถิ่น Builder
idea: Turns villagers' requests from community forums into a sub-district development plan with projects mapped to provincial strategy.
twist: Checks each project against expected budget and flags requests that belong to another agency's mandate.

name: Child Protection Case Conference
idea: Organises a child-welfare case file into a risk assessment and service plan for the multidisciplinary team meeting.
twist: Highlights conflicting statements between school, hospital and family reports for the social worker to resolve.

name: Fake Broker Ad Hunter
idea: Finds investment ads impersonating licensed Thai brokers or funds and builds timestamped evidence packs for the regulator.
twist: A human-supervised honeybot replies to the ad to capture the bank accounts and LINE IDs used.

name: Money Trail Mapper
idea: Normalises bank statements from many banks into one schema and traces scam money through layers of mule accounts for an investigating officer.
twist: Produces a court-ready fund-flow chart where every arrow links back to the source statement line.

name: Thai Trademark Similarity Examiner
idea: Compares a new trademark application against registered marks visually and by Thai pronunciation, as a trademark examiner would.
twist: Handles Thai-script look-alikes and sound-alikes that differ only by tone marks or vowel spelling.

name: Burn Scar Verifier
idea: Matches satellite hotspots and burn scars with field reports to separate crop burning, forest fires and false alarms for a provincial office.
twist: Prioritises patrol routes for forest-fire volunteers by smoke drift toward towns.

name: EIA Measures Tracker
idea: Checks a project's periodic environmental monitoring report against each mitigation measure promised in its approved EIA.
twist: Lists measures with no reported data or results trending out of range, for the environmental reviewer.

name: PIPO Vessel Inspector
idea: Helps Port-In Port-Out inspectors cross-check a fishing vessel's logbook catch against its VMS track and landing declaration.
twist: Scores which arriving vessels to inspect first based on track anomalies and catch inconsistencies.

name: ปศุสัตว์ Outbreak Investigator
idea: Helps a district livestock officer investigate a suspected livestock disease outbreak by tracing animal movements and vector risk.
twist: Draws the control and surveillance zones and drafts the movement-ban notice for the officer's approval.

name: Withdrawal Period Gate
idea: Checks farm treatment records against each drug's withdrawal period before pigs or chickens are sent to slaughter.
twist: Asks the farm vet by voice to confirm any treatment missing from the log before release.

name: 2Q·9Q·8Q Counsellor Copilot
idea: Helps a community-hospital nurse run Thai depression and suicide-risk screening, scoring it and routing per the local care pathway.
twist: Listens for risk cues in the patient's own words that contradict a low questionnaire score.

name: Home Fall-Risk Assessor
idea: A caregiver photographs an older person's home; the tool flags fall hazards and proposes home modifications with costs.
twist: Prepares the request to the local long-term care fund in the format the sub-district office expects.

name: ถุงยาเยี่ยมบ้าน · home med reconciliation
idea: A home-visit pharmacist photographs an older patient's bag of medicines; pills are identified and reconciled against hospital records.
twist: Spots duplicate drugs from different hospitals and expired stock hoarded at home.

name: Thai Braille Exam Transcriber
idea: Converts school exam papers, including maths and Thai tone marks, into Thai braille for special-education centres.
twist: Flags diagrams and tables that need tactile redrawing and writes alt descriptions for them.

name: Accessible Building Auditor
idea: Checks photos and tape measurements of a public building's ramps, toilets and parking against Thai accessibility regulations.
twist: Ranks fixes by cost and impact for the building owner and drafts the response to the complaint.

name: ศูนย์ไกล่เกลี่ย Mediation Prep
idea: Prepares a court mediation file for consumer credit-card debt cases, summarising the claim, payments and realistic settlement options.
twist: Gives the mediator side-by-side instalment scenarios the debtor can afford based on stated income.

name: OPD Flow Twin
idea: Builds a digital twin of a provincial hospital's outpatient flow from queue timestamps to find where patients wait longest.
twist: Tests fixes such as moving lab draws earlier before the hospital changes anything.

name: ประกันสังคม Appeal Drafter
idea: Explains a Social Security Office benefit rejection in plain Thai and drafts the worker's appeal with supporting documents.
twist: Points out which missing medical or employment evidence most likely caused the rejection.

name: Labour Inspector Visit Pack
idea: Prepares a labour inspector's workplace visit from complaints, past violations and payroll samples, with an interview checklist.
twist: Interviews migrant workers in their language and turns answers into the inspector's findings form.

name: Alcohol Ad Checker
idea: Checks bar and restaurant social-media posts against Thai alcohol advertising restrictions before they are published.
twist: Explains which element is risky, such as drinking scenes or promotions, and suggests a compliant rewrite.

name: ACTD Dossier Checker
idea: Checks a generic drug registration dossier in ASEAN Common Technical Dossier format for missing or inconsistent parts before Thai FDA submission.
twist: Cross-checks strengths, shelf life and manufacturer names across modules to catch reviewer queries early.

name: ไตอาหาร · renal diet planner
idea: Helps a hospital dietitian plan Thai meals for chronic kidney disease patients within potassium, phosphorus and protein targets.
twist: Suggests swaps for everyday Thai dishes and street food rather than unfamiliar Western menus.

name: ปภ. Situation Report Builder
idea: Merges district and village disaster reports into a provincial disaster office's standard situation report with affected-household counts.
twist: Detects duplicate or conflicting counts across districts before figures go to the governor.
